title: Qualify bounded exact symbolic execution, source proof provenance and M4-W01 closure
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded symbolic execution and close M4-W01

contribution.summary: Qualify M4-W01-C03-T2 with a compiled missing-API RED, 26 GREEN tests and eight NuGet-only oracles. Introduce a provider-free synchronous dispatcher for four qualified exact rules, with input/output node, depth and combined work budgets, typed cancellation/soft deadline refusals and math-ir/1 structural source provenance. Verify preview.4 local package identities and relevant IR/quantities regressions; close C03 and W01, leaving M4 and W02 open.
contribution.value: Make bounded symbolic work and refusal outcomes explicit without declaring a hard preemptive deadline, general CAS, lost domain condition, or agent broker authorization.
debtChanges: One true compiled reflection RED runs on the existing preview.3 product before staging any new bounded execution source or preview.4 package.
26 scientific GREEN tests cover the four closed rules, structural source provenance, exact node/depth/work caps, cancellation, soft deadlines and explicit unsupported outcomes.
Input and output costs are both counted; unknown rule IDs, extraneous options, symbolic binders and contradictory assumptions never become successful outputs.
Soft time and cancellation checks happen before and after bounded in-process work; no forced hard preemption, external CAS cancellation or OS sandbox is claimed.
Eight independent NuGet-only C# client oracles check real algebra, status/provenance, work refusals, cancellation, deadline, capture refusal and CAS-free dependencies.
Three generated local net10 NuGet archives receive independent manifest/dependency/byte/SHA-256 inspection, without recalculating DWF or planning authority hashes.
After complete relevant regressions, only C03-T2 R/G/V, T2, C03 and W01 reach done; M4 remains active, W02 stays not-ready and no public NuGet or AURA/dw.discovery integration is claimed.

RS058 pre-attempt refusal: ValidatePlan --write found no evidence array on newly completed work package M4-W01. The payload now aggregates ten durable C01/C02/C03 receipts (including new T2 RED/qualification) before the done-state projection; scientific tests and scope are unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS058 success, prepare M4-W02-C01-T1 for a narrowly proven symbolic function/differentiation contract, with units/domain boundaries and controlled RED/GREEN tests.
